description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Regulations made to amend the Import Regulations Published in Ex. Ord. No. 1813/14 of 05.06.2013 and No. 1518/04 of 08.10.2007 by including the item Arecanuts
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Import and Export (Control) Act, amending import regulations and license fees. It deals with legal/regulatory matters (amendments to existing regulations and fee structures) rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the regulatory content, not the primary focus.
